adjuster_notes: NWS confirmed straight-line wind event with recorded gusts of 72 mph at nearby weather station. Damage pattern consistent with wind-driven debris impact. Siding repair requires removal and replacement of two 4x8 sections. Window replacement for cracked double-pane unit. Deck railing section needs full replacement to match existing style. All repairs approved under standard homeowner wind damage coverage.
description: A severe windstorm with gusts exceeding 70 mph blew debris into the property, causing significant damage to the east-facing exterior. A large tree branch punctured the vinyl siding in two locations and cracked a double-pane window in the dining room. The rear deck railing was struck by a section of a neighbor's fence that became airborne, snapping three balusters and bending the top rail. Multiple homes in the area sustained similar wind damage.
